# Expected verdicts for the backup fixture with pull-request lookups
# working. backup-expected-degraded.txt is the same fixture with the
# forge unreachable. The reason keys are documented in expected.txt.
#
# test/fixtures/backup_repo.rb says how each backup is built.
#
# branch                 verdict  reason                      why
main                     KEEP     protected:default           the default branch, and where HEAD is
backup/w-squashed        DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       a two-commit backup of a branch squashed to one; the merged head carries its tree
backup/x-grew-pre-squash DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       labelled, and the branch gained a commit after the squash, so the tree is an earlier commit's and the name needs its label cut off
backup/y-conflicted      DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       the default branch edited the same lines later, so the content check conflicts and the rule is reached from the pull-request stage
backup/aa-layer          DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       the branch merged as a stack layer based on the layer below; its merge commit is on the default branch
backup/aj-two            DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       three merged pull requests: one head this clone lacks, one with another tree, and the last carries the backup's
backup/z-differs         KEEP     proof-b:backup-differs      the merged head carries a file the backup never had
backup/ac-absent         KEEP     proof-b:backup-head-absent  the merged head is in no local object, so no tree was read
backup/ab-elsewhere      KEEP     proof-a:tip-only            the branch merged into a release branch by a commit the default branch does not contain, so no pull request qualifies
backup/ad-fork           KEEP     proof-a:tip-only            the merged pull request for the branch came from a fork, so no pull request qualifies
backup/ae-closed         KEEP     proof-a:tip-only            the pull request for the branch closed unmerged
backups/af-plural        KEEP     proof-a:tip-only            a matching tree and a merged pull request, and not under backup/
backup/ah-reverted       KEEP     kept:not-landed             the default branch reverted the story, so the content check keeps the backup before any pull request is read
backup/ai-open           KEEP     protected:open-pr           a backup with a pull request open on it; protection runs first
backup/ak-clean          DELETE   proof-a:content-landed      a one-commit backup; the content check clears it and no pull request is needed
backup/al-ancestor       DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       the rewrite never happened: the story carried on from the backup, so every commit on it is in the merged head
backup/an-own-job        DELETE   proof-b:pr-merged           a feature branch under backup/ with its own merged pull request at this tip; a hyphen-cut name matching another pull request does not keep it
backup/ao-v2             DELETE   proof-b:backup-landed       labelled v2, and a closed pull request is named ao-v2; the merged one for ao still clears it
backup/ap-merge-absent   KEEP     proof-a:tip-only            a stack layer whose merge commit is in no local object, so nothing shows it reached the default branch
